follow100Note: Merchant solutions brings in $75.42 of every $100 — mostly a cut of merchants' sales — but it is also the expensive part to run: direct costs eat $51.09 of every $100 overall. Rows may not add exactly due to rounding.
footerNote: The earnings release prints a condensed statement (operating income $343M, net other expense including taxes of $79M, net income $264M); the split of that $79M into other expense, the equity-method loss and tax comes from the detailed statement in Shopify's Form 10-Q filed the same day, as the release itself directs.
oneTimers: A $103M after-tax drag from equity investments: a $62M unrealized (paper) loss on equity and other investments, a $29M unrealized loss on the embedded derivative tied to Shopify's convertible notes (due November 1, 2025), and a $21M loss on its equity-method investment. Shopify says net income excluding the impact of equity investments was $367M (non-GAAP), versus $264M GAAP.
otherDetail: Other expense of $35M in total: $81M of interest income was outweighed by a $62M unrealized (paper) loss on equity and other investments, a $29M unrealized loss on the embedded derivative tied to the convertible notes, and a $4M foreign-exchange loss. The $21M equity-method loss is the separate equityM line; the rest nets to otherIncomeM of -$14M.

segments.name: Subscription solutions
segments.note: The monthly plans merchants pay to run their stores on Shopify. Up 15% YoY.

segments.name: Merchant solutions
segments.note: Mostly payment processing (Shopify Payments) — a cut of the sales flowing through merchants' stores — plus shipping and other merchant services. Up 38% YoY and 75% of all revenue.

sources.label: Form 10-Q — detailed statements of operations (SEC EDGAR)

takeaways.text: Revenue rose 32% to $2.84B, the ninth straight quarter of double-digit free cash flow margins, as GMV grew 32% to $92.0B. Merchant solutions led, up 38% to $2.15B, while subscription revenue grew 15% to $699M and monthly recurring revenue reached $193M.
takeaways.title: Growth held at full speed

takeaways.text: Free cash flow was $507M — 18% of revenue — from $513M of operating cash flow and just $6M of capital spending (capex — money spent on property and equipment). Operating income rose 21% to $343M.
takeaways.title: Cash generation is the quiet story

takeaways.text: Net income fell to $264M from $828M a year ago, even though operating income rose 21%. A year ago Shopify booked a $512M paper gain on equity investments; this quarter it booked a $62M paper loss, a $29M loss on an embedded derivative and a $21M equity-method loss — $103M after tax. Excluding equity investments, net income was $367M.
takeaways.title: Investment swings shrank the bottom line

verdict: Shopify grew revenue 32% to $2.8B and generated $507M of free cash flow, but paper losses on its equity investments cut net income to $264M even as operating income rose 21%.
